subject: prd/self-drive-wake
statement: If a state read fails or is rate-limited, then the state reader shall report the affected proposals as unknown-retry-later, and no consumer-visible state transition shall be derived from the failure.
rationale: a 429 read as "no" drives wrong recovery (predecessor-paid, §2.4)
fit_criterion: injected 429/5xx/timeout fixtures yield typed unknown; a consumer test asserts zero transitions during the injection window
